sloka: ततः प्रेक्ष्य हनूमन्तं व्रजन्तं यत्र राघवः।स होतुकामो दुष्टात्मा गतश्चैत्यनिकुम्भिलाम् ।। ६.८२.२५ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prekṣya hanūmantaṁ vrajantaṁ yatra rāghavaḥ।sa hotukāmo duṣṭātmā gataścaityanikumbhilām ।। 6.82.25 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith reaching Nikumbhilam, the sacrificial ground, poured oblation of blood into the sacrificial fire for Devatas and the fire blazed.
